entities.summary: The Al-Aybaki Mosque, also referred to as the Mosque of Sheikh Abdullah al-Aybaki, was a mosque situated in the al-Tuffah neighborhood of Gaza City, in the State of Palestine. It was destroyed by an Israeli airstrike on 16 September 2025.
